mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS below 4.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.8, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 110 (INDPRO) indicates supply chain constraints that increase inflation expectations and equity risk premiums, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1350 (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand that reduces consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1350, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 210 (CPIAUCSL) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 138,000 thousand) indicates resilient labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 138000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust supply-side expansion that reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
